svg.title: Jones oxidation of a primary alcohol: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Hydrate chromate ester + base → PhCO2H + reduced chromium species. Removal of the remaining carbon H forms the acid carbonyl. Further chromium disproportionation/speciation is not assigned unique SORG digits.
